📅 2023-11-12 siege , encirclement, bombardment INC-089
the medical staff, patients, and their families, remain besieged in the hospital with no food, water, or electricity

On 13 November, a joint convoy of the PRCS with the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) heading to Al Quds hospital in Gaza city to evacuate patients, was forced to return after it left Khan Younis, due to the relentless bombardment and insecurity around the hospital. The medical team, patients, and their families, reportedly remain besieged in the hospital with no food, water, or electricity

Sources: 🔗 ochaopt
View full incident →
📅 2023-11-10 encirclement , snipers shots INC-088
the hospital generator has failed, and unfixable due to sniper fire

On 11 November, it was reported that Al Quds hospital’s generator had failed, and technicians were unable to fix it due to sniper fire. Out of the most critical patients, seven are in the ICU and three babies are in incubators.

Sources: 🔗 ochaopt
View full incident →
📅 2023-10-29 bombardment-vicinity INC-087
The bombardments targeted PRCS warehouses next to the hospital, which led to severe debris and dust entered the hospital, provocing inhalation and suffocation among patients, medical staff, and IDPs.

One of the attacks on 30 October was against the PRCS warehouses next to Al Quds Hospital, in Tel Al Hawa neighbourhood of Gaza city, where damages due to nearby bombardment resulted in severe debris and dust entering the hospital with inhalation and suffocation among patients, staff, and IDPs.

Sources: 🔗 ochaopt

📅 2023-08-11 siege INC-081
the main generator was shut down, the surgical ward, oxygen generation plant and MRI ward have shut down.

On 8 November, Al Quds Hospital in Gaza city announced that its main generator had been shut down, and a smaller generator is being used instead to reduce fuel consumption. As a result, the surgical ward, oxygen generation plant and MRI ward, have had to shut down. The hospital will provide two hours of electricity a day for IDPs taking shelter in its facilities. The hospital has been isolated from neighbouring areas and is facing a severe shortage of food, baby formula, medicine and disposables.

Sources: 🔗 ochaopt

📅 2023-04-10 airstrike INC-079
the entrance of hospital was hit, two people were killed and the entrance was damaged.

On 4 November, the entrances of both Nasser Children's Hospital in Gaza city and Al Quds Hospital in Gaza city were reportedly hit during Israeli airstrikes. Two people were reportedly killed, dozens were injured, and damage was caused to the entrances of these health facilities. Al Quds Hospital is currently a refuge for about 14,000 IDPs.

Sources: 🔗 ochaopt
View full incident →
📅 2023-03-10 airstrike INC-078
directly hit, large but unconfirmed number of casualties

On the 3rd November, at about the same time, Al Quds hospital in Gaza city and the Indonesian hospital in northern Gaza were hit, reportedly during airstrikes, resulting in a large yet unconfirmed number of casualties.

Sources: 🔗 ochaopt
View full incident →
📅 2023-02-10 – 2023-08-11 Airstrike INC-077
the building next to the hospital was severely damaged. The inside of the hospital sustained damage, glasses shattered, partient beds and hospital equipments and the ceiling were damaged.

Several videos shows the entrance of the hospital after the damage from aerial bombardment. Satellite imagery reported by the Guardian on 11 November shows damage to roads and buildings around the hospital.

Sources: 🔗 theguardian
